mode: Built-in imagegen; technical layer extraction and packaging in Python
master:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production character master for a layered Live2D VTuber art project.
The supplied image is the character identity reference, not a layout to reproduce. Create ONE full-body front-view anime woman, Aoi Cetara, the young adult blue whale ocean princess from the reference. Preserve her recognisable face, very long icy-blue silver-white hair, elegant pale blue/white layered fantasy dress with long open-front overskirt, detailed silver and restrained soft-gold filigree, pearls, many ocean-crystal gems and white flowers. Keep the signature blue whale-tail hair ornament beside her tiara very visible. Retain rich accessories: tiara, hair flowers, small trailing pearl chains, earrings, choker with blue pendant, large chest ribbon, waist ribbons, waist chains, wrist jewelry, thigh jewel garter, elaborate white blue shoes. Predominantly very light blue, white and silver, tiny lavender and soft gold accents.
Composition: a single centered figure on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background, tall 2:3 canvas ideally 1536x2304 or larger. Head and torso straight forward, no body turn or contrapposto. Both arms angled slightly outward, both hands clearly visible apart from the skirt, fingers natural, both legs distinct and both shoes fully visible. Hair flows down to calf level, mostly to the sides and behind the body. Both eyes exactly front-facing, relaxed eyelids and eyebrows, lips gently CLOSED in an almost straight tiny neutral line. DEFAULT expression calm neutral natural: absolutely NO smile, no open mouth, no blush, no wink, no surprise.
Produce exquisite clean anime model rendering, fine well-separated edges, crisp readable blue-violet outlines, controlled soft shading, clean anatomically plausible hands. Hair strands, dress panels and dangling ornaments have legible boundaries. Balanced relatively narrow silhouette suitable for streaming. 5% transparent margin around entire silhouette, no cropping crown/hair/hands/feet/long skirt.
No typography, no labels, no boards, no inset portraits, no extra floating whale animal, no props, no background scene, no floor, no cast shadow, no glow halo. This is a neutral master art reference for subsequent part separation, not a finished rig.
backfill:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: hidden backfill plate for layered Live2D artwork.
EDIT TARGET is the attached full-body Aoi Cetara image. Keep EXACTLY the 1024x1536 full canvas, exact head position, exact face outline, body pose, limb positions, dress outline, palette, shading and proportions. Do NOT zoom, do NOT reposition, do NOT crop.
Create a hidden-art version of the same character with ALL HAIR, bangs, side strands, tiara, head flower ornaments, whale hair ornament, earrings and all facial features removed. Expose the COMPLETE smooth bald head shape with forehead and both ears behind the former hair, using matching pale skin and softly shaded anime style. The face must be BLANK skin: no eyes, no eyebrows, no nose mark, no mouth, no blush. Keep head size and chin position IDENTICAL. The top of the bald head is approximately y=67, chin at y=266 and face centered at x=508 on the 1024x1536 canvas. Fill the skin behind removed bangs and eyes naturally. Complete the neck underneath choker. Preserve every part of the DRESSED BODY below neck; fill sleeves and dress areas formerly covered by hair. Never remove clothing. Keep both arms, hands, legs, shoes, chest bow and dress accessories unchanged. Only reconstruct hidden clothed areas and head.
Transparent background with true alpha. No hair anywhere. No eye holes, no mouth hole, no props, no text, no background, no loose removed components. This is intentionally a bald blank-faced dressed mannequin underpainting, not a final portrait.
hair_back: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: hidden rear hair underpainting for a layered Live2D character. The image is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve the EXACT 1024x1536 framing and scale. Isolate and reconstruct only Aoi Cetara's very long icy-blue and silver-white HAIR from this image. Remove every trace of person, face, skin, clothing, jewelry, flowers, crown, hair jewelry, chains, whale ornament, shoes. Output hair alone with true alpha. The hair should extend from x~280 y~65 at the crown through the flowing side masses to x~80..945 and end near y~1000. No hair below y=1100; lower quarter of canvas empty. Very important: this is the BACK HAIR layer, so reconstruct a CONTINUOUS filled-in mass of long flowing hair behind where the face, shoulders, arms and torso were. NO face-shaped hole and no torso-shaped hole. Have clean pale blue locks crossing the entire central area between x=380..640 y=100..850; delicate silvery lavender strand shading and wavy tapered tips. Maintain the original outer hair silhouette as closely as possible. No forelock/bangs cutouts. This is the complete hidden rear wig/curtain art that will sit behind head and clothed body. Crisp refined same anime rendering. No text, no background, no glow.
face_components:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: separable 2D anime face component sprite sheet, for the Aoi Cetara Live2D art project. The image is a STYLE and CHARACTER reference only.
Produce a clean SQUARE true-transparent canvas with a precise 4 columns by 4 rows evenly spaced invisible grid, each cell contains one isolated small component centered with at least 20% clear margin; absolutely NO cell lines, NO text labels, NO face or head, NO whole character. All parts must match the reference's delicate pale blue/cyan iris, icy silver palette, blue-violet thin anime eyelashes and pale pink lip style, with crisp production art and flat transparent background. Fill these 16 cells in reading order:
Row 1: cell 1 complete pure eye-white almond left eye with faint lavender top shadow (NO IRIS, NO LASHES); cell 2 matching pure eye-white right eye; cell 3 complete round ocean-cyan iris WITHOUT pupil and WITHOUT white reflections (filled center cyan); cell 4 matching complete round iris WITHOUT pupil or reflections.
Row 2: cell 1 small vertical dark blue pupil alone; cell 2 matching small dark blue pupil alone; cell 3 white iris reflection/glint cluster alone; cell 4 matching white glint cluster alone.
Row 3: cell 1 isolated gently curved dark bluish upper eyelash for viewer-left eye; cell 2 matching eyelash for viewer-right eye; cell 3 delicate short LOWER eyelash pair left; cell 4 delicate short lower eyelash right.
Row 4: cell 1 isolated narrow dark mauve open mouth INTERIOR oval, no lip/teeth/tongue; cell 2 isolated short ivory upper TEETH crescent alone; cell 3 small soft pink TONGUE alone; cell 4 tiny neutral CLOSED mouth line, delicate muted rose brown, almost straight, not smiling.
The components are for layer extraction and future deformation; all parts fully visible, uncut, non-overlapping, naturally shaded, no ornaments, no layout background, no words. Eyes must remain elegant mature anime, not cartoon emoji. Make all row 1 eyes the same practical scale; all irises round with full hidden circumference. Each pupil is its own object, each glint its own object. Real transparent alpha is essential.
